source_note: Combines the previously consumed 30-case validation split and the previously consumed 30-case final holdout. This dataset is development-only and must never be reported as unseen generalization evidence.

architecture_targets.U_Q06_T02: multi-span composition should reduce the severe under-promotion; target within ±1 of human score.
architecture_targets.U_Q02_NEG: suspense boundary should prevent a personal dilemma/illness from becoming substantive suspense; target <=1.
architecture_targets.U_Q10_T30: polarity guard must suppress the deterministic cooperation cue in negative/contrast context. Final semantic score is secondary because the LLM may independently find teamwork-like collective action.
